facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's guidelines of May 2019 state that health data from most facilities is collected on paper and sent to the councils, where Council Health Management Teams enter it into the web-based DHIS; their annex adds that councils report to the Medical Stores Department through eLMIS and send financial data to national level via Epicor. They give no count of councils and do not say how the council offices are connected.
facts.system: Council-level entry into DHIS, eLMIS and Epicor

note: The one fact rests on council teams entering data in a national web-based system; no council office connection is described. The guidelines' rules that councils 'shall have' internet access and sufficient computers (7.3.3, 7.3.11) are requirements, not statements of what exists, and their gap statements (facilities mostly lack computers) concern health facilities.
